architecture.mechanism: Microbial mediated decay of monochloramine occurs as water passes through distribution systems with long hydraulic retention times
architecture.intervention: Implement a 'draw & fill' system to control hydraulic retention times and reduce microbial mediated monochloramine decay
architecture.expected_effect: Reduced biofilm regrowth and nitrification episodes while maintaining total chlorine residual above 1.0 mg/L at the farthest customer during 25 C summer demand without boosting disinfectant dose
architecture.falsification_test: Compare chlorine residual and nitrite levels in dead-end mains with and without the 'draw & fill' system implementation
